'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 David McCune LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' We'll handle this (I hope)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
